record.why: electrical identity and figures are vendor-cited in iterations/v0.0.1/electrical.*.json (that record's own verdict is PASS); the mechanical side — cad/interfaces.json names no frame, cad/part.py builds no geometry — was not measured in this lane, so the folder cannot grade itself better than CANNOT DETERMINE.
